adapters.authority: Nix lock plus Zed adapter record
adapters.immutable_output_identity: Nix store hash plus Zed artifact SHA-256
adapters.notes: Nix package and derivation interoperability remains governed by RFC 23.

adapters.platform_identity: Flox systems and locked catalog outputs
adapters.immutable_output_identity: Flox lock digest plus Zed environment-plan digest
adapters.notes: Only the fixed frozen-install activation hook is Zed-owned.

adapters.platform_identity: locked Nix package outputs and supported systems
adapters.immutable_output_identity: Devbox lock digest plus Zed environment-plan digest
adapters.notes: Existing user-owned packages, scripts, services, and variables are preserved.

adapters.platform_identity: tool backend, platform, checksum, and source revision
adapters.immutable_output_identity: mise lock digest plus Zed environment-plan digest
adapters.notes: Parent, global, local, and environment-derived configuration is excluded by default.

adapters.authority: .tool-versions plus pinned plugin provenance in Zed lock state
adapters.platform_identity: plugin commit, platform, and tool checksum
adapters.immutable_output_identity: plugin revision and artifact checksum plus plan digest
adapters.notes: Exact tool versions alone are insufficient without immutable plugin provenance.

adapters.authority: OCI image layout and immutable manifest digest
adapters.platform_identity: OCI platform descriptor and per-platform manifest digest
adapters.notes: Docker is a runtime adapter over the same normalized OCI content as Podman.

adapters.authority: OCI image layout and immutable manifest digest
adapters.platform_identity: OCI platform descriptor and per-platform manifest digest
adapters.notes: Podman is a runtime adapter over the same normalized OCI content as Docker.

adapters.authority: npm package identity plus Zed native-registry adapter record
adapters.platform_identity: package name or native selector outside the version
adapters.immutable_output_identity: package name, exact version, and artifact SHA-256
adapters.notes: A generic package may select explicitly named platform packages at the same SemVer.

adapters.authority: Cargo package identity plus Zed native-registry adapter record
adapters.platform_identity: crate/package identity and target metadata outside the version
adapters.immutable_output_identity: package name, exact version, and artifact SHA-256
adapters.notes: Cargo requirement syntax is translated source-aware before one exact lock version is selected.
